do.text: Use a cascader when the options form a tree people walk: region, country, city.

dont.text: Don't wrap three flat sizes in a cascader: a select or a toggle group shows them at once.

title: Keep the path when names repeat

do.text: Show the path when leaves share a name, so `settings / page.tsx` differs from `app / page.tsx`.

dont.text: Don't show only the leaf when several leaves are called `page.tsx`: the field no longer says which one.
